ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes and identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals.
questions: How do Medicaid fraud schemes typically operate?
What are the most common ways that individuals and entities launder money in Medicaid fraud schemes?
ideas.insight: I believe that by analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals involved in Medicaid fraud schemes, and potentially uncover new leads and suspects.
